ValidationRule.description: #10773 : Book to Bill: Update Permissions to allow Implementation Team to Move Deals from Stage 5 to 6 & Stage 6 to 7 #21200- Making the VR applicable for all profiles except Admins #21201Users with permissionset Move Opportunity to Stage 6 are bypassed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISPICKVAL( StageName , '6 - Setup'),
$Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator",
NOT($Setup.Users_allowed_to_update_Oppty_to_Stage6__c.Allowed_Users__c),
$Permission.NCSP_NAS_Blended = FALSE,
NOT( $Permission.Update_Stage_of_Closed_Opportunities ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to update an Opportunity to Stage 6. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
